height_and_interior_caveat: The source asset started as a 16 m high massing extrusion. Exterior reference supports a lower public south wing and a taller set-back performance wing qualitatively. The 16 m upper wing and 11.5 m lower roof are estimates, not survey measurements. A 2.7 m rooftop penthouse and interior room layout are illustrative. Program names and theatre capacity are source-supported; exact room placement and interior floor plans remain unverified.
